t.E400.agn: In 2017 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern for the general population.
t.E400.body: Alginates are not absorbed intact in the gut; in the large intestine they are partly fermented by bacteria into short-chain fatty acids.
t.E400.prod: Obtained from brown seaweeds by extraction.
t.E400.pw.0: EFSA reported that it could not fully evaluate the safety of this substance in foods for special medical purposes for infants and young children with the available data.
t.E400.pw.1: EFSA reported that it could not fully evaluate the safety of this substance in foods for special medical purposes for infants and young children with the available data.
t.E400.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed. Data insufficient for foods for special medical purposes for infants.
t.E400.summary: A polysaccharide obtained from brown seaweeds. It thickens and forms gels; used in ice cream and desserts.
t.E400.what: Used as a thickener, gelling agent and stabiliser.
